reference: ဒါဆို သရက်သီးနှစ်ကီလိုနဲ့ သင်္ဘောသီးတစ်လုံး ပေးပါဦး။
meaning: The buyer wants two kilograms of mangoes, the fruit they asked about first, and one papaya. Swapping the fruits or the amounts is wrong. "Us" is the buyers. "The other" is the papayas, which are sold by the piece, not by the kilo.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Is this the stall with the tea-leaf salad?

history.speaker: B
history.text: ဟုတ်ကဲ့။ ပုံမှန် လက်ဖက်သုပ်ကို လိုချင်သလား၊ အစပ်ကိုလိုချင်သလား။

history.speaker: A
history.text: What is in the spicy one?

history.speaker: B
history.text: ငရုတ်သီးနဲ့ လက်ဖက်သုပ်ပါ။ ကြက်သွန်ဖြူကြော်ထပ်ထည့်နိုင်ပါတယ်။

text: Hook me up with the spicy one, extra fried garlic, but tell them no dried shrimp. My gut is wrecked.
reference: အစပ်လက်ဖက်သုပ် ပေးပါ၊ ကြက်သွန်ဖြူကြော်ထပ်ထည့်ပေးပါ၊ ပုဇွန်ခြောက်တော့ မထည့်ပါနဲ့လို့ စားဖိုမှူးကို ပြောပေးပါ။ ကျွန်မ ဗိုက်မကောင်းလို့ပါ။
meaning: Order the spicy tea-leaf salad, add fried garlic, and tell the cook to leave out dried shrimp. "Hook me up" means please give me that. "My gut is wrecked" means the speaker's stomach is upset, not that an object is broken. "Them" is the cook at this stall.

history.speaker: A
history.text: We need a ride to the hotel, not the airport.

history.speaker: B
history.text: အပြာရောင်တက္ကစီက ဟိုတယ်ကိုသွားနိုင်ပါတယ်။ ယာဉ်မောင်းက ကတ်မယူဘူး၊ ငွေသားပဲယူပါတယ်။

history.speaker: A
history.text: I see two cars that could be it.

history.speaker: B
history.text: အဝတ်ဖြူဝတ်ထားတဲ့ ယာဉ်မောင်းကို စီးပါ။ လေဆိပ်သွားမယ့်ကားက အညိုရောင်တက္ကစီပါ။

text: Pint the driver in the white shirt, not the brown taxi. I need crash because the cart machine is down.
reference: အဝတ်ဖြူဝတ်ထားတဲ့ ယာဉ်မောင်းကို ညွှန်ပြပါ၊ အညိုရောင်တက္ကစီမဟုတ်ပါဘူး။ ကတ်စက်ပျက်နေလို့ ငွေသားလိုပါတယ်။
meaning: Get the attention of the driver in the white shirt, not the brown taxi. The speaker needs cash because the card machine is broken. Autocorrect: "pint" means point to, not a beer and not paint. "Crash" means cash, not an accident. "Cart" means card, not a shopping cart. The airport car is the one to refuse.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Excuse me, we have a reservation.

history.speaker: B
history.text: ကြိုဆိုပါတယ်ခင်ဗျာ။ ဘွတ်ကင်ကို ဘယ်နာမည်နဲ့ လုပ်ထားပါသလဲ၊ ဘယ်နှစ်ညနေပါသလဲ။

history.speaker: A
history.text: It should be under U Than. We also asked for a quiet room.

history.speaker: B
history.text: စစ်ဆေးပေးပါ့မယ်ခင်ဗျာ။ တစ်ခန်းက လမ်းဘက်မျက်နှာမူပြီး၊ တစ်ခန်းက နောက်ဘက်မှာရှိပါတယ်။

text: Could you please check us in under U Than, for two nights, the quiet room you mentioned? Not the one facing the street.
reference: ကျေးဇူးပြုပြီး ဦးသန်းနာမည်နဲ့ နှစ်ညအတွက် စာရင်းသွင်းပေးပါ၊ တိတ်ဆိတ်တဲ့အခန်းမှာနေချင်ပါတယ်၊ လမ်းဘက်မျက်နှာမူတဲ့အခန်းမဟုတ်ပါဘူး။
meaning: Polite request to the hotel receptionist, not to a friend. Booking name U Than, two nights, the quiet room at the back, not the room facing the street. Polite register to the receptionist. Slang or a familiar pronoun is wrong. Clerk gender was not stated.

history.speaker: A
history.text: How do we walk to the station from here?

history.speaker: B
history.text: ဒီလမ်းပေါ်မှာ စခန်းနှစ်ခု ရှိပါတယ်။ ကျွန်တော်ပြပေးနိုင်ပါတယ်။

history.speaker: A
history.text: Which one has the train to the airport?

history.speaker: B
history.text: အဓိကစခန်းက မီးပွိုင့်ရဲ့ နောက်ဘက်မှာ ရှိပါတယ်။ စခန်းသေးလေးက စျေးနဲ့ ဆန့်ကျင်ဘက်မှာ ရှိပြီး၊ ဒီစခန်းကတော့ လေဆိပ်ကို မသွားပါဘူး။

text: မင်းပြောခဲ့တဲ့ ပထမစခန်း၊ မီးပွိုင့်ရဲ့ နောက်ဘက်က အဓိကစခန်းကို ကျွန်တော်တို့ သွားမှာပါ၊ စျေးနဲ့ ဆန့်ကျင်ဘက်က စခန်းသေးလေးကို မဟုတ်ပါဘူး။
reference: We'll take the first one you mentioned, the station after the traffic light, not the one across from the market.
meaning: B is the guide. The speaker wants the main station, the one B described first, after the traffic light, and not the small station across from the market. Do not swap the stations. No person other than the guide is being pointed at.

history.speaker: A
history.text: The doctor told aunt to buy a painkiller, and she gets drowsy on the strong one.

history.speaker: A
history.text: I can point at the box if you tell me the name they will recognize.

text: ဆေးဆိုင်က ညာဘက်မှာ ရှိပါတယ်။ paracetamol 500 mg လိုချင်တာပါ၊ သူ့ကို အိပ်ငိုက်စေတဲ့ ဆေးကို မလိုချင်ပါဘူး။
reference: The pharmacy is on the right. We need paracetamol 500 mg, not the one that makes she drowsy.
meaning: The pharmacy is on the right. Buy paracetamol 500 mg, not the medicine that causes drowsiness. Keep the Latin token "paracetamol" and the number 500. Do not swap in a different drug. Aunt is the patient.

history.speaker: A
history.text: We need somewhere to sit and charge the phone.

history.speaker: B
history.text: ဒီကော်ဖီဆိုင်မှာ ထပ်နှစ်ထပ် ရှိပါတယ်။ အပေါ်ထပ်က ပိုတိတ်ဆိတ်ပါတယ်။

history.speaker: A
history.text: Is the drink any good, or just the chairs?

history.speaker: B
history.text: နို့လက်ဖက်ရည်က လူတွေအများဆုံး မှာကြတဲ့ ဟာပါ။ အောက်ထပ်က ဆူညံပါတယ်။

text: ဒီမှာ Wi-Fi က နှေးပေမယ့်၊ နို့လက်ဖက်ရည်ကတော့ ကောင်းပါတယ်။ အပေါ်ထပ်မှာ ထိုင်လို့ရမလား။
reference: The Wi-Fi here is slow, but the milk tea is good. Can we sit upstairs?
meaning: The speaker wants to sit upstairs because downstairs is noisy, and wants the milk tea. Keep the Latin token "Wi-Fi" and the fact that the connection is slow. Do not move them downstairs.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Are the people by the door with you?

history.speaker: B
history.text: ဟုတ်ကဲ့။ ကျွန်တော့်အစ်မကို စိမ်းရောင်လုံချည်ဝတ်ထားတာ တွေ့ရပါလိမ့်မယ်။ သူမရဲ့ရည်းစားကတော့ အနက်ရောင်ဂျာကက်ဝတ်ထားပြီး သူမဘေးမှာ ရပ်နေပါတယ်။

history.speaker: A
history.text: Which of them should I talk to? I saved one seat.

history.speaker: B
history.text: ကျွန်တော့်အစ်မကို ပြောပါ။ သူမရဲ့ရည်းစားက သူမကို ဒီကိုလိုက်ပို့ရုံပါပဲ။ သူမက အရက်မသောက်ပါဘူး။

text: စိမ်းရောင်လုံချည်ဝတ်ထားတဲ့ ကျွန်တော့်အစ်မကို၊ ပြတင်းပေါက်ဘက်ထိုင်ခုံလိုချင်သလား မေးပေးပါ။ သူမရဲ့ရည်းစားကိုတော့ မဟုတ်ပါဘူး။ ပြီးတော့ ဘီယာလည်း မလိုအပ်ပါဘူး၊ ကျွန်တော့်အစ်မက အရက်မသောက်ပါဘူး။
reference: Ask my sister, the one in the green longyi, if she wants the window seat. Not her boyfriend in the black jacket. And no beer: she does not drink alcohol.
meaning: Ask my sister, who is wearing the green longyi, whether she wants the window seat. Do not ask her boyfriend in the black jacket. She does not drink alcohol, so the speaker is not offering beer. Flipping her and him, or dropping the negation, is wrong.

history.speaker: A
history.text: How much for the mangoes and the rambutans?

history.speaker: B
history.text: ស្វាយមួយគីឡូប្រាំមួយពាន់រៀល។ សាវម៉ាវមួយផ្លែបួនពាន់រៀល។

history.speaker: A
history.text: The mangoes look a bit underripe. Are they sweet?

history.speaker: B
history.text: ស្វាយផ្អែមហើយ។ សាវម៉ាវក៏ទុំដែរ។

text: Then give us two kilos of the first one, and one of the other.
reference: អញ្ចឹងសូមឱ្យស្វាយពីរគីឡូ និងសាវម៉ាវមួយផ្លែ។
meaning: The buyer wants two kilograms of mangoes, the fruit they asked about first, and one rambutan. Swapping the fruits or the amounts is wrong. "Us" is the buyers. "The other" is the rambutans, which are sold by the piece, not by the kilo.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Is this the stall with the fish amok?

history.speaker: B
history.text: បាទ/ចាស។ អ្នកចង់បានអាម៉ុកត្រីធម្មតា ឬបែបហឹរ?

history.speaker: A
history.text: What is in the spicy one?

history.speaker: B
history.text: ម្ទេស និងអាម៉ុកត្រី។ យើងអាចបន្ថែមបាយបាន។

text: Hook me up with the spicy one, extra rice, but tell them no peanuts. My gut is wrecked.
reference: សូមឱ្យខ្ញុំអាម៉ុកត្រីហឹរ បន្ថែមបាយ ហើយប្រាប់ចុងភៅកុំដាក់សណ្តែកដី។ ក្រពះខ្ញុំមិនស្រួល។
meaning: Order the spicy fish amok, add rice, and tell the cook to leave out peanuts. "Hook me up" means please give me that. "My gut is wrecked" means the speaker's stomach is upset, not that an object is broken. "Them" is the cook at this stall.

history.speaker: A
history.text: We need a ride to the hotel, not the airport.

history.speaker: B
history.text: តុកតុកក្រហមអាចទៅសណ្ឋាគារបាន។ អ្នកបើកបរមិនទទួលកាត ទទួលតែលុយសុទ្ធ។

history.speaker: A
history.text: I see two cars that could be it.

history.speaker: B
history.text: សូមជិះជាមួយអ្នកបើកបរដែលពាក់មួកពណ៌ខៀវ។ តុកតុកពណ៌ខៀវគឺជារថដែលទៅព្រលានយន្តហោះ។

text: Pint the driver in the blue cap, not the blue tuk-tuk. I need crash because the cart machine is down.
reference: សូមចង្អុលទៅអ្នកបើកបរដែលពាក់មួកពណ៌ខៀវ មិនមែនតុកតុកពណ៌ខៀវទេ។ ខ្ញុំត្រូវការលុយសុទ្ធ ព្រោះម៉ាស៊ីនកាតខូច។
meaning: Get the attention of the driver in the blue cap, not the blue tuk-tuk. The speaker needs cash because the card machine is broken. Autocorrect: "pint" means point to, not a beer and not paint. "Crash" means cash, not an accident. "Cart" means card, not a shopping cart. The airport car is the one to refuse.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Excuse me, we have a reservation.

history.speaker: B
history.text: សូមស្វាគមន៍។ ការកក់បន្ទប់នេះធ្វើឡើងក្រោមឈ្មោះអ្វី ហើយសម្រាប់ប៉ុន្មានយប់?

history.speaker: A
history.text: It should be under Dara. We also asked for a quiet room.

history.speaker: B
history.text: ខ្ញុំអាចពិនិត្យបាន។ បន្ទប់មួយបែរមុខទៅផ្លូវ ហើយមួយទៀតនៅខាងក្រោយ។

text: Could you please check us in under Dara, for two nights, the quiet room you mentioned? Not the one facing the street.
reference: សូមមេត្តាចុះឈ្មោះចូលស្នាក់ឱ្យយើងខ្ញុំក្រោមឈ្មោះដារ៉ា សម្រាប់ពីរយប់ ក្នុងបន្ទប់ស្ងប់ស្ងាត់ មិនមែនបន្ទប់ដែលបែរមុខទៅផ្លូវនោះទេ។
meaning: Polite request to the hotel receptionist, not to a friend. Booking name Dara, two nights, the quiet room at the back, not the room facing the street. Polite register to the receptionist. Slang or a familiar pronoun is wrong. Clerk gender was not stated.

history.speaker: A
history.text: How do we walk to the station from here?

history.speaker: B
history.text: មានស្ថានីយពីរនៅផ្លូវនេះ។ ខ្ញុំអាចបង្ហាញបាន។

history.speaker: A
history.text: Which one has the train to the airport?

history.speaker: B
history.text: ស្ថានីយធំស្ថិតនៅក្រោយភ្លើងចរាចរណ៍។ ស្ថានីយតូចស្ថិតនៅទល់មុខផ្សារ ហើយស្ថានីយនោះមិនទៅព្រលានយន្តហោះទេ។

text: យើងនឹងយកស្ថានីយធំដែលនៅក្រោយភ្លើងចរាចរណ៍ដែលអ្នកបានលើកឡើងមុននេះ មិនមែនស្ថានីយដែលនៅទល់មុខផ្សារនោះទេ។
reference: We'll take the first one you mentioned, the station after the traffic light, not the one across from the market.
meaning: B is the guide. The speaker wants the main station, the one B described first, after the traffic light, and not the small station across from the market. Do not swap the stations. No person other than the guide is being pointed at.

history.speaker: A
history.text: The doctor told younger sibling to buy a painkiller, and they gets drowsy on the strong one.

history.speaker: B
history.text: ឱសថស្ថាននៅជ្រុងនេះលក់ច្រើនប្រភេទ។

history.speaker: A
history.text: I can point at the box if you tell me the name they will recognize.

history.speaker: B
history.text: និយាយឈ្មោះថ្នាំ និងកម្រិតថ្នាំ ហើយប្រាប់ថាអ្នកមិនចង់បានប្រភេទដែលធ្វើឱ្យងងុយគេងទេ។

text: ឱសថស្ថាននៅខាងឆ្វេង។ យើងត្រូវការ paracetamol 500 mg មិនមែនប្រភេទដែលធ្វើឱ្យងងុយគេងទេ។
reference: The pharmacy is on the left. We need paracetamol 500 mg, not the one that makes they drowsy.
meaning: The pharmacy is on the left. Buy paracetamol 500 mg, not the medicine that causes drowsiness. Keep the Latin token "paracetamol" and the number 500. Do not swap in a different drug. Younger sibling is the patient.

history.speaker: A
history.text: We need somewhere to sit and charge the phone.

history.speaker: B
history.text: កាហ្វេនេះមានពីរជាន់។ ជាន់លើស្ងាត់ជាង។

history.speaker: A

meaning: The buyer wants two kilograms of strawberries, mentioned first, and one apple. Do not swap the fruits or the amounts.

history.speaker: A
history.text: 여기가 김치찌개 하는 집 맞아요?

history.speaker: B
history.text: はい。普通ですか、辛いのですか?

history.speaker: A
history.text: 매운 게 너무 맵다면 순한 걸로 할게요.

history.speaker: B
history.text: 辛いのには唐辛子が入っています。豆腐を追加できます。海鮮は抜けます。

text: 매운 걸로 주시고 두부 많이 넣어주세요, 근데 해산물은 빼주세요. 배가 완전 꼬였어요.
reference: 辛いキムチチゲをください。豆腐を多めにして、海鮮は抜いてください。お腹の調子が悪いです。
meaning: Order the spicy kimchi stew, add tofu, and leave out seafood. The speaker's stomach is upset. Do not translate any idiom as physical destruction.

history.speaker: A
history.text: 실례합니다, 예약했는데요.

history.speaker: B
history.text: いらっしゃいませ。お名前と、何泊でしょうか?

history.speaker: A
history.text: 김으로 예약되어 있을 거예요. 조용한 방을 부탁드렸어요.

history.speaker: B
history.text: 一つの部屋は通り側で、もう一つは奥にございます。

text: 김으로 이틀 밤 체크인 부탁드려도 될까요, 조용한 방으로요? 거리 쪽을 향한 방 말고요.
reference: キムという名前で二泊、静かな部屋でチェックインをお願いいたします。通りに面した部屋ではなく。
meaning: Polite request to the receptionist. Booking name Kim, two nights, the quiet back room, not the street-facing room. Use a polite register in both the source line and the reference. Familiar slang is wrong. Clerk gender was not stated.

history.speaker: A
history.text: 역까지 어떻게 걸어가요?

history.speaker: B
history.text: この道には駅が二つあります。

history.speaker: A
history.text: 공항 가는 기차는 어디서 타요?

history.speaker: B
history.text: 本駅は信号の後にあります。小さい方は市場の向かいにあり、空港には行きません。

text: 우리가 원허는 곶은 신호등 지나서 왼쪽에 있어요, 시장 맞은편에 있는 곳이 아니고.
reference: 私たちが行きたいのは信号の後の左側です。市場の向かいのところではありません。
meaning: The speaker wants the station on the left after the traffic light, not the one across from the market. Typos must be recoverable and must not flip left, right, or the negation.

history.speaker: A
history.text: आम और अनार कितने के हैं?

history.speaker: B
history.text: المانجو بثمانين روبية للكيلو. الرمان بأربعين روبية للحبة.

history.speaker: A
history.text: आम कच्चे लग रहे हैं। क्या ये मीठे हैं?

history.speaker: B
history.text: المانجو حلوة بالفعل. الرمان ناضج.

text: तो पहले वाले के दो किलो दे दीजिए, और दूसरे का एक।
reference: إذن أعطنا من فضلك كيلوين من المانجو وحبة رمان واحدة.
meaning: The buyer wants two kilograms of mangoes, mentioned first, and one pomegranate. Do not swap the fruits or the amounts.

history.speaker: A
history.text: क्या यही वो जगह है जहाँ बिरयानी मिलती है?

history.speaker: B
history.text: نعم. عادية أم حارة؟

history.speaker: A
history.text: अगर तीखी वाली सच में बहुत तेज़ है, तो हल्की वाली ठीक रहेगी।

history.speaker: B
history.text: الحارة فيها فلفل حار. يمكننا إضافة الرايتا. يمكننا حذف الفول السوداني.

text: भाई, तीखी वाली ही दे दे, रायता ज़्यादा डाल देना, पर मूंगफली बिल्कुल मत डालना। पेट खराब है मेरा।
reference: من فضلك أعطني البرياني الحار، مع رايتا إضافية، وبدون فول سوداني. معدتي مضطربة.
meaning: Order the spicy biryani, add raita, and leave out peanuts. The speaker's stomach is upset. Do not translate any idiom as physical destruction.

history.speaker: A
history.text: माफ़ कीजिए, हमारा आरक्षण है।

history.speaker: B
history.text: مرحباً. ما الاسم، وكم عدد الليالي؟

history.speaker: A
history.text: यह शर्मा के नाम पर होना चाहिए। हमने शांत कमरे का अनुरोध किया था।

history.speaker: B
history.text: إحدى الغرف تطل على الشارع والأخرى في الخلف.

text: क्या आप कृपया हमें शर्मा के नाम से चेक इन कर देंगे, दो रातों के लिए, शांत वाला कमरा? वो नहीं जो सड़क की तरफ है।
reference: من فضلك سجّلنا باسم شارما لمدة ليلتين، في الغرفة الهادئة، وليس الغرفة المطلة على الشارع.
meaning: Polite request to the receptionist. Booking name Sharma, two nights, the quiet back room, not the street-facing room. Use a polite register in both the source line and the reference. Familiar slang is wrong. Clerk gender was not stated.

history.speaker: A
history.text: स्टेशन तक हम कैसे पैदल जाएँ?

history.speaker: B
history.text: في هذا الطريق محطتان.

history.speaker: A
history.text: किस वाली में एयरपोर्ट की ट्रेन है?

history.speaker: B
history.text: المحطة الرئيسية بعد إشارة المرور. المحطة الصغيرة مقابل السوق ولا تذهب إلى المطار.

text: जो स्टेसन हमें चाहिय वो बाईं तरफ ट्रैफ़िक लाइट के बाद है, वो नहीं जो बाज़ार के सामने है।
reference: المحطة التي نريدها على اليسار بعد إشارة المرور، وليست التي مقابل السوق.
meaning: The speaker wants the station on the left after the traffic light, not the one across from the market. Typos must be recoverable and must not flip left, right, or the negation.

history.speaker: A
history.text: بكم البرتقال والتين؟

history.speaker: B
history.text: संतरे पांच दिरहम किलो हैं। अंजीर एक दिरहम प्रति अंजीर है।

history.speaker: A
history.text: البرتقال يبدو غير ناضج. هل هو حلو؟

history.speaker: B
history.text: संतरे पहले से ही मीठे हैं। अंजीर पके हुए हैं।

text: إذن أعطنا كيلوين من الأولى، وواحدًا من الأخرى.
reference: फिर कृपया हमें दो किलो संतरे और एक अंजीर दे दीजिए।
meaning: The buyer wants two kilograms of oranges, mentioned first, and one fig. Do not swap the fruits or the amounts.

history.speaker: A
history.text: هل هذا هو المكان الذي يقدم شاورما الدجاج؟

history.speaker: B
history.text: हाँ। सामान्य या तीखी?

history.speaker: A
history.text: العادية تكفي إذا كانت الحارة حارة جدًا فعلاً.

history.speaker: B
history.text: तीखी वाली में मिर्च होती है। हम लहसुन की चटनी डाल सकते हैं। हम तिल छोड़ सकते हैं।

text: جهزلي الحارة، زيادة ثوم، بس من غير سمسم. معدتي مش مزبوطة خالص.
reference: कृपया मुझे तीखी चिकन शावरमा दीजिए, ज्यादा लहसुन की चटनी के साथ, और तिल नहीं। मेरा पेट खराब है।
meaning: Order the spicy chicken shawarma, add garlic sauce, and leave out sesame. The speaker's stomach is upset. Do not translate any idiom as physical destruction.

history.speaker: A
history.text: عفوًا، لدينا حجز.

history.speaker: B
history.text: स्वागत है। किस नाम से, और कितनी रातों के लिए?

history.speaker: A
history.text: يجب أن يكون باسم حسن. لقد طلبنا غرفة هادئة.

history.speaker: B
history.text: एक कमरा सड़क की ओर है और एक पीछे की ओर है।

text: هل يمكنكم تسجيل دخولنا باسم حسن، لليلتين، في الغرفة الهادئة؟ ليس الغرفة المطلة على الشارع.
reference: कृपया हमें हसन के नाम से दो रातों के लिए चेक-इन करें, शांत कमरे में, सड़क की ओर वाले कमरे में नहीं।
meaning: Polite request to the receptionist. Booking name Hassan, two nights, the quiet back room, not the street-facing room. Use a polite register in both the source line and the reference. Familiar slang is wrong. Clerk gender was not stated.

history.speaker: A
history.text: كيف نمشي إلى المحطة؟

history.speaker: B
history.text: इस सड़क पर दो स्टेशन हैं।

history.speaker: A
history.text: أيهما فيه القطار إلى المطار؟

history.speaker: B
history.text: मुख्य स्टेशन ट्रैफिक लाइट के बाद है। छोटा स्टेशन बाजार के सामने है और हवाई अड्डे के लिए नहीं जाता।

text: الذي نريدة هو على اليسار بعد الإشارة الضوئية، وليس الذي اماو السوق.
reference: जो हमें चाहिए वह ट्रैफिक लाइट के बाद बाईं ओर है, न कि वह जो बाजार के सामने है।
meaning: The speaker wants the station on the left after the traffic light, not the one across from the market. Typos must be recoverable and must not flip left, right, or the negation.
